entries.note: 403.5.1: the clear width of walking surfaces shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.
403.5.3: passing spaces shall be either a 60 inch (1525 mm) minimum by 60 inch (1525 mm) minimum space, or an intersection of two walking surfaces providing a T-shaped space.
304.3.1: the turning space shall be a space of 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter minimum.
404.2.3: door openings shall provide a clear width of 32 inches (815 mm) minimum.
904.4.1: a portion of the counter surface 36 inches (915 mm) long minimum and 36 inches (915 mm) high maximum above the finish floor.
904.4, through 904.4.1 and 904.4.2: the accessible portion of a sales or service counter is 36 inches (915 mm) high maximum above the finish floor.
305.3: the clear floor or ground space shall be 30 inches (760 mm) minimum by 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum.
303.3: changes in level between 1/4 inch (6.4 mm) high minimum and 1/2 inch (13 mm) high maximum shall be beveled with a slope not steeper than 1:2.
404.2.7: handles, pulls, latches, locks and other operable parts shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum above the finish floor.
404.2.9: interior hinged doors and gates, 5 pounds (22.2 N) maximum.
302.3: openings shall not allow passage of a sphere more than 1/2 inch (13 mm) diameter.
603.2.1: turning space complying with 304 shall be provided within the room, which 304.3.1 sets at 60 inches (1525 mm) diameter minimum.
404.2.4 and table 404.2.4.1: a front approach to the pull side of a swinging door requires 60 inches (1525 mm) minimum perpendicular to the doorway.
307.2: objects with leading edges more than 27 inches (685 mm) and not more than 80 inches (2030 mm) above the finish floor shall protrude 4 inches (100 mm) maximum horizontally.
308.2.1: where a forward reach is unobstructed, the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum above the finish floor.
902.3: the tops of dining surfaces and work surfaces shall be 28 inches (710 mm) minimum and 34 inches (865 mm) maximum above the finish floor.

405.2 Slope. Ramp runs shall have a running slope not steeper than 1:12. EXCEPTION: In existing sites, buildings, and facilities, ramps shall be permitted to have running slopes steeper than 1:12 complying with Table 405.2 where such slopes are necessary due to space limitations.
405.6 Rise. The rise for any ramp run shall be 30 inches (760 mm) maximum.
405.5 Clear Width. The clear width of a ramp run and, where handrails are provided, the clear width between handrails shall be 36 inches (915 mm) minimum.
405.7.3: 405.7 Landings. Ramps shall have landings at the top and the bottom of each ramp run. 405.7.3 Length. Landings shall have a clear length of 60 inches (1525 mm) long minimum.
405.8 Handrails. Ramp runs with a rise greater than 6 inches (150 mm) shall have handrails complying with 505.

505.4 Height. Top of gripping surfaces of handrails shall be 34 inches (865 mm) minimum and 38 inches (965 mm) maximum vertically above walking surfaces, ramp surfaces, and stair nosings. Handrails shall be at a consistent height above walking surfaces, ramp surfaces, and stair nosings.

308.2.1 Unobstructed. Where a forward reach is unobstructed, the high forward reach shall be 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low forward reach shall be 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish floor or ground. Referenced by 309.3, which places operable parts within one or more of the reach ranges specified in 308.

305.3 Size. The clear floor or ground space shall be 30 inches (760 mm) minimum by 48 inches (1220 mm) minimum. 305.5 Position. Unless otherwise specified, clear floor or ground space shall be positioned for either forward or parallel approach to an element.

904.5.1 Self-Service Shelves and Dispensing Devices. Self-service shelves and dispensing devices for tableware, dishware, condiments, food and beverages shall comply with 308, which sets the high forward reach at 48 inches (1220 mm) maximum and the low forward reach at 15 inches (380 mm) minimum above the finish floor or ground.
